plan.purpose: Short fixed-schedule CPA+FIA versus CPA+FIA+deterministic-bin-and-radius pilot
plan.weight_calibration: Public-only gradient norms at shared initial candidate; fixed throughout both branches
plan.quantization_scale_floor: median of strictly-positive public row steps; original cells and final exact codes unchanged
plan.labels: Private; initialize both from public starting classifier applied to common warmup images; update hybrid logits through observation only
plan.arm_difference: Adding the complete bin-plus-radius objective, including its image and private-label gradients
plan.evaluation: Same final artifacts, all16, offline MSE-Hungarian once per arm then PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS; final exact codes and radius, soft/hard fit; no private early stopping or candidate selection
plan.decision_rule: Report signed differences in image and observation metrics without a success cutoff; mixed directions are inconclusive. Single pilot cannot establish general superiority or impossibility. Equal iterations and shared schedule, not equal wall-clock time.

log_timing: losses, gradients and entropy are pre-step; displacement and clamp are post-step; final fits use the saved post-step pixels/logits
